title: Sum the orders
prompt: Sum the amount column of the orders file and write {"total": <sum>} as JSON to out/summary.json. After your change, run `sh tools/regen.sh` to refresh generated files, and make sure your change survives it.

files.tools/regen.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Refresh generated files from templates/.
set -e
mkdir -p out
echo ran > out/.regen.ran
mkdir -p "$(dirname 'out/summary.json')"
cp 'templates/out/summary.json' 'out/summary.json'
